title: Argentinian Empanadas with Creamy Veal Filling
description: A classic Argentinian recipe featuring empanadas filled with a rich and creamy veal mixture.
instructions: 2. In a pan, sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
3. Add the veal and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces.
4. Stir in the cream and bring to a simmer.
5. Season with yeast, salt, and black pepper.
6. Roll out the empanada dough and cut into circles.
7. Place a tablespoon of the veal mixture in the center of each circle.
8. Fold the dough over and press the edges to seal.
9. Brush the tops with egg wash and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
